notes: No official register (Cuc Thu y / DAH, city vet associations) or poison line was reachable: dah.gov.vn and nonglam.edu.vn were refused by WebFetch (PROVENANCE_REQUIRED); VNUA vet hospital page (khoathuy.vnua.edu.vn) redirected http<->https without loading. Nha Trang, Da Lat, Hoi An, Phu Quoc clinics only appeared on aggregator/blog pages (olympiamedic.com, phongkhamthuy.net) and were not published; their own sites not yet opened (dalatpet.com refused). Left: Hanoi/HCMC university hospitals, Nha Trang, Da Lat (Da Lat Pet, Doctor Hi), Hoi An, Phu Quoc, Hue, Can Tho, other HCMC clinics (New Pet Hospital, Pet Pro, Petzone). No animal poison line found. Independent check 2026-11-11: all 10 source pages opened and confirmed (names, phones, 24-h wording); Animal Doctors International states 24/7 emergency for Vietnam as a whole, not per branch.
